WITH base AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode, b.tgtcode AS tgtcode, b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `m1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode, tgtcode
FROM base
WHERE (`m1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode, tgtcode;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode, b.tgtcode AS tgtcode, b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.volume AS `m1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode, tgtcode
FROM base
WHERE (`m1` >= ? AND `m1` < ?)
ORDER BY mktcode, tgtcode;

WITH base AS (

prefiltered AS (

rank_input AS (

WITH history AS (
  SELECT pf.mktcode AS mktcode,pf.tgtcode AS tgtcode,pf.bizdate AS bizdate,
    pf.ma60 AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.stock_daily_features_v2 pf
  WHERE pf.bizdate = ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    `v1` AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`f1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=5 THEN AVG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`f1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT history.*, `v1` - LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) AS `price_delta`
  FROM history
),
features AS (
  SELECT deltas.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(price_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 14 THEN 100 - 100 / (1 + (AVG(GREATEST(price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) / NULLIF(AVG(GREATEST(-price_delta,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 13 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`
  FROM deltas
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`f1` > ?)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

features AS (

  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?

SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE ((`f1` + ?)>=? AND (`f1` + ?)<=?)

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    `v1` AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
predicates AS (
  SELECT features.*,
    (`f1` > ?) AS `pc1`
  FROM features
),
counted AS (
  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`
  FROM predicates
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM counted WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE `c1`
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;

),

  SELECT predicates.*,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3 THEN (SUM(CASE WHEN `pc1` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)=3) ELSE NULL END AS `c1`
  FROM predicates
),
current_rows AS (

)

FROM current_rows

WITH history AS (
  SELECT b.mktcode AS mktcode,b.tgtcode AS tgtcode,b.bizdate AS bizdate,
    b.closePrice AS `v1`,
    b.openPrice AS `v2`
  FROM newzl.v_hsj_stock_hq_basic b
  WHERE b.bizdate <= ?
),
features AS (
  SELECT history.*,
    CASE WHEN `v1` IS NOT NULL AND `v2` IS NOT NULL AND LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) IS NOT NULL AND LAG(`v2`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate) IS NOT NULL THEN (`v1`>`v2` AND LAG(`v1`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate)<=LAG(`v2`) OVER (PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate)) ELSE NULL END AS `f1`
  FROM history
),
current_rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM features WHERE bizdate = ?
)
SELECT mktcode,tgtcode
FROM current_rows
WHERE (`f1` = ?)
ORDER BY mktcode,tgtcode;
